review:
Superstar Sevens gives the classic sevens theme Hacksaw's cascade treatment. Landing a Lightning symbol together with a win activates the Cascade Counter: removed non-winning symbols turn into a multiplier, each removed symbol adds to it, and the final win is multiplied once all cascades finish. An Epic Lightning adds another multiplier.

Three FS symbols give 10 free spins with more Lightning, four give 10 spins with Lightning on every spin, and five unlock the top bonus. Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP, volatility or max win outside the game. It suits players who like classic symbols with modern multipliers.
